newsitem.title: UK: NWE gasoline holds steady in falling crude market.
newsitem.headline: NWE gasoline holds steady in falling crude market.

text.p: NWE gasoline was broadly steady on Thursday, seemingly resistant to crude's sharp drop.
Eurograde barges were hobring around $187/8 fob ARA.
Traders said material in the barge market was tightish after recent arb movements to the United States, but that prices probably would ease if crude's drops were extended tomorrow.
The arb narrowed on Thursday, having been wide open yesterday.
Fob cargoes were about $4 or so off barges.
Nigeria's demand continues to support the European gasoline market, particuarly in the Mediterranean.
"The Med is going to be stronger than NWE, but could still ease a bit," said one dealer.
Gasoline swaps were thin, but July traded at $188.50 and Augsut at $187.50 a couple of times.
